diagram.alt: A bar split into 4 equal parts with 3 shaded

hint: Look at the denominators. When they match, the pieces are all the same size, so you can count them together.

hints.text: Look at the denominators. When they match, the pieces are all the same size, so you can count them together.
Both fractions are fourths. Keep the denominator $4$ and add the numerators $1 + 2$ to count the fourths.
$1 + 2 = 3$, so the sum is $\frac{3}{4}$, three fourths.

explanation: Both fractions have the denominator $4$, which means every piece is the same size.
Because the pieces match, add how many there are: $1 + 2 = 3$ pieces.
The pieces are still fourths, so the sum is $\frac{3}{4}$.
